answer: A saffron caravan crosses one dune pass per agent on a fixed voyage between two oasis wells. Each agent seals a weighed pouch of saffron threads with a numbered wax stamp at the first well, and one camel carries that pouch alone across the dunes to the second well. The keeper there weighs the pouch again and checks the seal number against the departure log, and a short weight or broken seal voids the run. A thousand fake names need a thousand camels, a thousand weighed pouches, and a thousand dune crossings, and one camel crosses the pass once a day.
